Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 4, Verse 37

“As a kindled fire reduces firewood to ashes, Arjuna, so the fire of knowledge reduces all actions to ashes.”

The fire image returns, now with the fuel specified. Actions are firewood — substantial, stacked up, and entirely consumable once something hot enough reaches them.
